issues.description: The problem statement requires implementing init_world(width, height) (two parameters) to set both dimensions, but the solution's init_world only reads a single parameter from the stack (only handles width). The template also does not provide a stub for init_world, which can leave students uncertain about the expected calling convention and parameter layout.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the parameter expectation consistent across artifacts. Either (A) update the solution to read both width and height from the stack (e.g. mov eax, [esp+4] ; width and mov ebx, [esp+8] ; height) and document this in a stub added to the template, or (B) change the problem statement to require init_world(width) only. Also add an init_world stub in the template (with the correct two-parameter calling layout if option A is chosen) so students have a clear placeholder and calling convention to implement against.
